tables.name: Loot (Minor)
tables.description: What a pocket, a crate or a small cache holds. Luck-touched: the best finds are at the top.
entries: 01-02: Nothing but lint and a dead beetle.
03-04: A bent copper coin and a button. | currency: 1d4
05-06: A small purse of coins. | currency: 2d6
07: A roll of clean linen. | item: Linen Bandages
08: [[Trinkets]]
09: [[Trinkets]] and a few coins. | currency: 1d6
10: A stoppered vial of something red and warm. | item: Healing Draught
11: A pot of greasy salve that smells of mint. | item: Burn Salve
12: A worn knife with a good edge. | item: Hedge Knife
13: A leather sling and a pouch of river stones. | item: Shepherd's Sling
14: A heavier purse, sewn shut. | currency: 4d6
15: A pouch of smelling salts and a crumpled map. | item: Smelling Salts
16: A small silver ring worth a fair price. | currency: 30
17: A sturdy hatchet wrapped in oilcloth. | item: Woodsman's Hatchet
18: A padded jacket, patched but whole. | item: Padded Jack
19: A flask of something that makes your heart hammer. | item: Courage Tonic
20: A merchant's strongbox, forgotten. | currency: 6d10

tables.name: Loot (Major)
tables.description: A boss's hoard, a noble's vault or a dragon's leftovers. Luck-touched.
entries: 01-02: A chest of old coins, half of them fake. | currency: 5d10
03-04: A chest of good coins. | currency: 10d10
05: Two healing draughts in a padded box. | item: Healing Draught | item: Healing Draught
06: [[Loot (Minor)]] and a jeweled hairpin. | currency: 40
07: A fine arming sword with a plain scabbard. | item: Arming Sword
08: A flanged mace with a dented head that has seen use. | item: Flanged Mace
09: A coat of hardened leather that fits like it was made for you. | item: Hardened Leather
10: A hunting bow and a quiver of fletched arrows. | item: Hunting Bow
11: A hand crossbow small enough to hide in a coat. | item: Hand Crossbow
12: A chain hauberk, oiled and rolled in a sack. | item: Chain Hauberk
13: A vial of thick green liquid that smells like a swamp. | item: Troll-Blood Elixir
14: A greater healing draught sealed with wax. | item: Greater Healing Draught
15: A slender stiletto with a thorn-shaped point. | item: Thornpoint Stiletto
16: A wand that is warm to the touch. | item: Ember Wand
17: A sabre whose blade ripples like river water. | item: Riverglass Sabre
18: A rod of rowan wood bound in silver. | item: Rowan Ward-Rod
19: A suit of half-plate stamped with a forgotten crest. | item: Bastion Half-Plate
20: A glass orb with a storm trapped inside, and a pile of gold. | item: Thunderglass Orb | currency: 10d10

tables.name: Trinkets
tables.description: Small, odd things with no price and a story behind them.
entries: A wooden die with a seven where the six should be.
A locket holding a lock of white hair.
A key that fits no lock anyone has found.
A tin soldier missing its head.
A letter addressed to someone who died a century ago.
A smooth black stone that is always cold.
A pressed flower that still smells fresh.
A whistle that only dogs seem to hear.
A tooth too large to belong to any animal you know.
A coin from a kingdom nobody has heard of.
A thimble engraved with a tiny map.
A glass eye that seems to follow you.
A spool of thread that never runs out. Or so it seems.
A child's drawing of a castle with too many towers.
A compass that points to the nearest tavern.
A bell with no clapper that rings anyway, once a day.

tables.name: Road Encounters
tables.description: What happens on a day's travel along a road.
entries: 01-03: The road is quiet. Birdsong, dust and sore feet.
04: A merchant's wagon has lost a wheel; the driver begs for help and offers a reward. | currency: 2d10
05: A shrine by the road, with fresh offerings and no keeper in sight.
06: A pack of {1d4+1} rats the size of dogs swarms out of a ditch. | npc: 1d4+1 Giant Rat
07: Wolves pace the travellers from the treeline, waiting for a straggler. | npc: 1d3+1 Grey Wolf
08: A log across the road; it's an ambush. | npc: 1d3+1 Road Bandit
09: Arrows from the ridge: bandits who'd rather not come close. | npc: 1d2 Road Bandit | npc: 1d2 Bandit Archer
10: A patrol stops the travellers and asks too many questions.
11: A pilgrim shares a rumor: [[Plot Hooks]]
12: A bandit captain and their crew demand a toll. | npc: Bandit Captain | npc: 1d3 Road Bandit

tables.name: Wilderness Encounters
tables.description: What waits off the road: forests, hills and caves.
entries: 01-02: Nothing but wind in the trees and the feeling of being watched.
03: A clear spring; anyone who drinks feels rested.
04: Tracks of something huge, pressed deep into the mud.
05: A wolf pack defends its den. | npc: 1d4+1 Grey Wolf
06: A nest of giant rats in a hollow log. | npc: 2d3 Giant Rat
07: An abandoned camp with a cold fire and a half-written journal.
08: A hermit offers shelter for the night, in exchange for a story.
09: Bandits hiding out in a ruin. | npc: 1d3 Road Bandit | npc: Bandit Archer
10: The ground shakes; a cave troll comes looking for dinner. | npc: Cave Troll
11: A lost child who says their village is just over the hill. There is no village.
12: An old tower with a light in the top window.

tables.name: NPC Quirks
tables.description: A quick habit or trait to bring an NPC to life.
entries: Speaks only in questions.
Hums the same three notes when nervous.
Constantly polishes a ring that isn't there.
Laughs at the wrong moments.
Calls everyone by the wrong name, confidently.
Collects buttons and asks for yours.
Never sits with their back to a door.
Quotes a holy book, slightly wrong.
Smells strongly of onions and is proud of it.
Whispers, so everyone has to lean in.
Keeps a tally of every favor owed, in a little book.
Refuses to say the name of a certain city.
Has a pet crow that repeats the last word said.
Tells the same story about a bear, with a different ending each time.
Is far too interested in the weather.
Bites coins to check them, even copper ones.
Treats every stranger like an old friend.
Wears gloves, even indoors, even in summer.
Flinches at the sound of bells.
Speaks of themself in the third person.

tables.name: Plot Hooks
tables.description: Seeds for an adventure or a scene.
entries: 01: {1d4+1} villagers have gone missing from the same street, one each full moon.
02: A noble offers {4d10+20} gold to anyone who can find their runaway heir, no questions asked.
03: The well in the town square has started whispering at night.
04: A ship arrived in port with no crew and a full cargo of [[Trinkets]].
05: The local temple's relic was swapped for a fake; the priests haven't noticed yet.
06: Wolves have been seen walking on two legs at the forest's edge.
07: A dying soldier presses a sealed letter into someone's hand: 'Take it to the capital.'
08: The harvest festival is in {1d6} days and the mayor has received a threat.
09: A map tattooed on a dead smuggler's back leads into the old mines.
10: Two rival guilds both hire the party, for opposite jobs.
11: The bridge toll has tripled and the new toll-keeper wears a bandit's scarf.
12: A traveling circus came to town, and the children follow it everywhere.
13: A tower that has been empty for years has a light in the window again.
14: Someone is selling healing draughts that make people forget their names.
15: An old friend of one of the characters turns up, wanted for murder.
16: The river has turned red upstream, and the fish are dying.
17: A bell rings in the ruined chapel every night at midnight. The bell was melted down decades ago.
18: A merchant pays well for escorts, and refuses to say what is in the locked wagon.
19: The town's cats have all disappeared overnight.
20: A stranger in the tavern knows every character's name, and says they've been expected.
